name: Ascendis Pharma A/S
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-11), cover page: American Depositary Shares, each representing one ordinary share, nominal value DKK 1 per share (Nasdaq: ASND)
ads_ratio.reason: DATA_GAP:ads_ratio — the filer's own 20-F states one ADS represents one ordinary share, so per-ordinary-share figures are directly comparable to the traded price with no scaling. (Post-period: on April 20, 2026 all ADSs were mandatorily exchanged 1-for-1 into ordinary shares directly listed on Nasdaq under the same ASND ticker, per the company's April 8/20, 2026 GlobeNewswire releases — the 1:1 basis is unchanged.)

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

f_subtype_basis: sum of the last 3 fiscal years (the median window)

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-11), Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows (p. F-8): the combined acquisition line for intangible assets and property, plant and equipment is €8,485 thousand for FY2025, with €1,427 thousand for FY2024 and €2,442 thousand for FY2023 in the same statement
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — no PPE-only purchase tag is filed for FY2024/FY2025 because the filer reports PPE and intangible acquisitions on one combined cash-flow line (proof of basis: the FY2023 combined €2,442k is exactly the engine's last filed capex — €2,442k at the recorded 1.105 ECB rate = $2,698,410 in financials_history.csv). The combined line is an upper bound on PPE-only capex (it also buys intangibles), so subtracting it is conservative for owner's earnings. The engine applies this single FY2025 value to every missing period: for FY2024 it overstates the filed combined €1,427k by ~€7.1M, immaterial against FY2024 operating cash flow of -€306.2M and conservative in direction. Capex at this scale cannot change the sign of any year's OE (FY2025 OCF +$63.3M vs SBC $136.5M). Declared in EUR, the reporting currency; the engine FX-converts at period-end rates.

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-11), Note 5 Earnings Per Share: the weighted average number of ordinary shares for the purposes of basic and diluted earnings per share is 60,607,131 for FY2025, with 57,891,570 for FY2024 and 56,287,060 for FY2023 in the same table; basic and diluted EPS are identical in all three years (€(3.76) / €(6.53) / €(8.55))
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — no separate diluted count is tagged because Ascendis was loss-making in FY2023-2025: Note 5 states the outstanding warrants, RSUs/PSUs and the 575,000 convertible senior notes (convertible into 3,456,785 ordinary shares) were excluded from diluted EPS as antidilutive, so the filer's diluted denominator is the combined basic-and-diluted count in the EPS note. The engine applies this single FY2025 value to every missing period; for FY2023/FY2024 it is a larger denominator than the filer's own counts (56,287,060 / 57,891,570), which shrinks the negative OE/share toward zero — the direction runs against a harsher verdict, and the normalized base stays deeply negative on either basis (-$7.21/share on the filed per-year counts).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency EUR converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-11), cover page: American Depositary Shares, each representing one ordinary share, nominal value DKK 1 per share (Nasdaq: ASND)) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-11), Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows (p. F-8): the combined acquisition line for intangible assets and property, plant and equipment is €8,485 thousand for FY2025, with €1,427 thousand for FY2024 and €2,442 thousand for FY2023 in the same statement); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-11), Note 5 Earnings Per Share: the weighted average number of ordinary shares for the purposes of basic and diluted earnings per share is 60,607,131 for FY2025, with 57,891,570 for FY2024 and 56,287,060 for FY2023 in the same table; basic and diluted EPS are identical in all three years (€(3.76) / €(6.53) / €(8.55))); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass. F sub-type: no cash generation (OCF - capex is not positive).

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
